sentences.en: Attempts to fight the fire with buckets soon proved fruitless.
sentences.zh: 试图用水桶扑灭火灾很快证明是徒劳的。

sentences.en: Give me the metal bucket with the oil in it.
sentences.zh: 给我那个装有油的金属水桶。

sentences.en: Always keep a bucket of water handy, in case of fire.
sentences.zh: 随时准备一个水桶用来防火。

senses.zh: 水桶；（机器上的）桶装物；大量
